mapper.select: SELECT ts_code, stock_name, reason, explanation, abnormal_type, net_buy, total_buy, total_sell, billboard_deal_amt, change_rate, close_price, turnoverrate, free_market_cap, d1_close_adjchrate, d5_close_adjchrate FROM dragon_tiger FINAL WHERE trade_date = #{tradeDate} ORDER BY net_buy DESC

SELECT ts_code, seat_name, seat_type, rank, buy, sell, net_buy, net_buy_ratio, trade_amt, trade_direction FROM dt_detail FINAL WHERE trade_date = #{tradeDate} AND ts_code = #{tsCode} ORDER BY rank ASC
SELECT ts_code, seat_name, seat_type, rank, buy, sell, net_buy, net_buy_ratio, trade_amt, trade_direction FROM dt_detail FINAL WHERE trade_date = #{tradeDate} ORDER BY ts_code ASC, rank ASC
